description: Cross-language cases for contracts/rules/topic-naming.md. Each case decorates ClassName.methodName with useQueue/use_queue plus the given options and asserts the published QueueMessage's eventName and metadata.topic. null means 'option not set'.

cases.name: auto topic, no service, no event name override
event name override does not change the auto topic
event name override with service keeps service.ClassName.methodName
explicit topic wins over event name override and service
